classification: post-outcome retrospective reproduction and applicability audit

A_graph_switch.reason: No observationally identical alternate-graph pairs or no-change graph controls

B_grading.reason: Only a two-point causal strength pilot with fixed observational magnitude

C_rescue.reason: Source-guidance prompts exist; no complete source-by-calculation factorial or matched placebo

information_dependence.reason: Plug-in estimates exist; eight families and post-outcome selection

neural_and_timing.reason: No precision restoration, logits, activations or validated cognitive timing

signal_detection.reason: Scheduled validity and binary response counts exist; latent parameters not identified
